scope: Stale Rescan repair: reproducible Session/renderer regressions, offline recorded gate, installed protected distribution and running-build verification. Native UI/live capture remain unverified.

reproducedBeforeFix.case: Disconnected capture with a confirmed manual position
reproducedBeforeFix.observed: Rescan reran Stockfish on the old FEN and returned Ready without reading any screen pixels.

reproducedBeforeFix.case: Native error from an earlier scan revision
reproducedBeforeFix.observed: The renderer reported unavailable under the new revision and stopped its scan.

reproducedBeforeFix.case: Native promise rejection from an earlier scan revision
reproducedBeforeFix.observed: The renderer reported frame-failed under the new revision and stopped its scan.

fixedBehavior: Rescan without a selected capture clears advice and exposes Select Board recovery instead of re-analyzing old state.
Connected Rescan sends stop before start/sample, clears the previous observation and resets stability to require two fresh samples.
Old native errors, rejected requests, pixels and decode completions are checked against both epoch and request session/revision.
Rescan preserves running/paused mode and the explicitly selected window; switching windows still requires Select Board.

verification.timingNote: This recognition run overlapped tests and packaging; its latency is not comparable with earlier idle runs.

limitations: Native window accessibility still times out, so visible panel state, saved Settings values and fresh live-board behavior were not verified in this installation.
Complete native fixture corpus and OS capture denial/revocation qualification remain incomplete.
